project: Port of Centralia homepage demo (spec sample for RFP response, due Nov 13, 2026)
goal: One production-quality homepage that shows the Port what their new site could be: faster, clearer, fully accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA / DOJ Title II), and easy to keep updated. Content is real, pulled from portofcentralia.com; anything not verified is a clearly marked placeholder.

stack.framework: Astro (static output, zero client JS by default; islands only where needed)
stack.styling: Plain CSS or Tailwind with design tokens; no UI kit that injects inaccessible markup
stack.content: Content collections (Markdown/JSON) for meetings, documents, news, and parks so the same data can feed an email-to-publish workflow later
stack.performance_targets: Lighthouse 100 accessibility, 95+ performance, SEO and best practices on mobile; LCP under 1.5s; total JS under 30 KB

audiences: Businesses and site selectors evaluating land, lease, build-to-suit, or relocation
Residents and taxpayers looking for meetings, agendas, minutes, and public notices
Contractors wanting to join the Small Works or A&E roster

brand_and_tone.voice: Plain-spoken, confident, civic. Short sentences. No jargon without explanation.
brand_and_tone.visual: Clean, modern industrial: deep navy or forest green primary, warm accent (safety orange or wheat), lots of white space, real photography of the parks and I-5 corridor (placeholder images labeled 'PHOTO: Park 3 aerial' etc.). Keep the existing Port logo.
brand_and_tone.contrast: All text and UI meet 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text and UI components); verify every color pair

elements: Skip to main content link (first focusable)
primary_nav: Industrial Parks (Park I, Park II, Park 3)
Do Business (Available Sites, Incentives & Bonds, Foreign Trade Zone, Rosters)
Meetings & Documents (Agendas & Minutes, Meeting Videos, Public Notices, Newsletters)
header.behavior: Keyboard-operable disclosure menus (button + aria-expanded), visible focus ring, mobile menu that traps nothing and closes on Escape

elements: Accessibility statement link with a way to report a barrier

accessibility_requirements: WCAG 2.1 AA throughout; semantic landmarks (header, nav, main, footer) and one h1 with logical heading order
All interactive elements reachable and usable by keyboard with visible focus
Meaningful alt text; decorative images empty alt
No information conveyed by color alone; link text that makes sense out of context (no 'click here')
Respects prefers-reduced-motion; no carousels or autoplay
Text resizes to 200% and reflows at 320px width without horizontal scrolling
Form fields with visible labels, error messages tied by aria-describedby
lang attribute set; page titles unique
Test with axe and Pa11y in CI plus a manual NVDA/VoiceOver and keyboard pass; include the report in the proposal

update_workflow_demo.idea: Staff email an agenda, minutes, or notice to a dedicated address (e.g. publish@...) and it appears on the right page after an automatic accessibility check, with staff approval by reply
update_workflow_demo.demo_scope: Show it working for one document type (meeting agenda) end to end, or as a short screen recording if not built in time
update_workflow_demo.fallback_editor: Keystatic or TinaCMS for occasional page edits by staff

seo: Title and meta description per page
LocalBusiness/GovernmentOrganization schema with address and hours
deliverables: Live preview URL on Cloudflare Pages
Lighthouse and axe reports (screenshots for the proposal)
constraints: Do not present the demo as the official Port site; add a small 'Concept demo by Stoke Leads' banner and noindex
Use only facts from portofcentralia.com; mark everything else PLACEHOLDER
Keep it to the homepage plus at most a meetings page
